title: Washroom Services for Leicestershire County Council
description:
A Further Competition was conducted under ESPO Framework 239_24 Service Providers to deliver a comprehensive range of Washroom Services across its estate, which includes approximately 260 sites. These services extend to partner organisations, including Local Authorities, Schools, and Academies. 

The scope of services includes, but is not limited to: 
* Collection and disposal of sanitary waste 
* Collection and disposal of nappy and incontinence waste 
* Collection and disposal of medical and sharps waste 
* Provision of roller towel dispensers 
* Rental of hand dryers 


The Contract is intended to be used by the Customer. The Customer may provide goods and/or services under this contract to schools, academies, universities, district councils, county councils, city councils, libraries, police forces, fire brigades and charities or similar organisations within the geographic regions of Leicestershire as listed below: 

* Contracting Authorities as defined in the Public Contract Regulations 2015  
* Schools and Academies as defined in the Education Act 1996 
* Charities as defined in the Charities Act 2011 
* Example contracting authorities based in Leicestershire are: 
* Blaby District Council 
* Charnwood Borough Council 
* East Midlands Ambulance Service 
* Harborough District Council 
* Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council 
* Leicester City Clinical Commissioning Group 
* Leicester City Council 
* Leicestershire County Council (The Lead Authority) 
* Leicestershire Fire and Rescue Service 
* Leicestershire Partnership NHS Trust 
* Leicestershire Police 
* Melton Borough Council 
* North West Leicestershire District Council 
* Oadby and Wigston Borough Council 
* University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust 
* Leicestershire Clinical Commissioning Groups 

Please note: the above list is not exhaustive and may change throughout the contract.

title: Tender for an E-Learning and Learning Management System
description:
The Council wishes to invite tenders for the supply of goods and services in respect of an eLearning platform and Learning Management System for Melton Borough Council (MBC), Charnwood Borough Council (CBC) and North West Leicestershire District Council (NWLDC).\r
\r
Three (3) Leicestershire councils known as Melton Borough Council (MBC), Charnwood Borough Council (CBC) and North West Leicestershire District Council (NWLDC) are looking to consolidate and upgrade their eLearning platforms and Learning Management System (LMS) with the primary purpose to share and provide general mandatory/statutory training, business skills and development for their people across a single platform.\r
\r
The intention of this procurement exercise is to identify a provider who can meet our requirements and enter into a 3 year agreement with an option to extend by a further 12 months based on successful annual review of the solution. \r
\r
The system will be a cloud-based Learning Management System which will house, deliver and track training for staff to ensure that the councils can meet their demands around compliance of mandatory training but also development of knowledge and skills across the whole workforce. \r

title: MH 0071 - Pest Control Services - AWARD
description:
The Contract will mainly be for treatment of Rats, Mice and Cockroaches but on occasion, Midland Heart will need the Contractor to deal with all pests listed below (list not exhaustive) -  
      
      Rats
      Bird mites
      Flies
      Mice
      Lice
      Dust Mites
      Cockroaches
      Fleas
      Ants
      Bed Bugs
      Wasps
      Silverfish
      Squirrels
      Hornets 
      
      The only exceptions are protected species & honeybees (where Midland Heart will decide on how to proceed following advice from the Contractor).
      
      The services will be delivered direct through the Contractors own staff and will not be subcontracted without written permission from Midland Heart.
      
      The above services are required across a range of different stock and tenure's including Void properties, General Needs properties, Retirement and Supported Living properties, Home Options (Leasehold and Shared Ownership) properties and Mutual Properties. 
      
      The Contract is expected to commence on the 6th of March 2023.
      
      Lot 1 - Birmingham, Wolverhampton, Sandwell, Dudley, Wychavon, Herefordshire, Redditch, Bromsgrove, Stroud, Shropshire UA, Swindon, West Oxfordshire, Cotswold, Tewkesbury, Worcester, Wyre Forest and Wiltshire UA.
      
      Lot 2 - Coventry, Leicester, Stoke on Trent, East Staffordshire, Tamworth, Nuneaton and Bedworth, Rugby, Lichfield, Cannock Chase, Northampton Borough Council, North Warwickshire, Hinckley and Bosworth, Charnwood, Walsall, East Northamptonshire, Solihull, Harborough, North West Leicestershire, Blaby, Milton Keynes, Oadby and Wigston, Staffordshire Moorlands, South Staffordshire, Warwick, Broxtowe, Rushcliffe, East Staffordshire, South Kesteven, Newcastle under Lyme, South Derbyshire, Kettering, South Northamptonshire, Wellingborough, Corby Borough Council and Stafford.
      
      Contractors should note, the splits outlined below are indicative only and may be subject to change throughout the life of the Contract.  
      
      Following evaluation of the compliant Tenders Midland Heart shall determine which profile of lot award demonstrates the most economically advantageous outcome and consequently the contract may be awarded to one or multiple contractors (i.e. a minimum of 1 or a maximum of 2).

title: Long-Acting Reversible Contraception (LARC) Service Direct Award
description:
This service is required to deliver the provision, fitting, monitoring, and removal of IUDs, IUSs and SDIs for contraception purposes for women of Leicestershire and Rutland.

The service will provide a number of clinics across the geography of the counties and ensure consistent and timely delivery of long-acting reversible contraception.

Service aims are:
- improve sexual health outcomes  
- improve access to long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) to Leicestershire and Rutland residents as part of a range of contraceptive options 
- to raise awareness of the benefits of Long-Acting Reversible Contraception (LARC) by providing high quality advice, support and information on the full range of contraception methods to all those on or seeking contraception
- to increase knowledge of LARC and mainstream contraception amongst healthcare professionals
- to increase knowledge of risks associated with sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and refer to appropriate services
- to help contribute to a reduction in the rate of unplanned pregnancies, particularly in under 18s.   
- to enhance professional practice
- to enable Providers to be active participants in an integrated multi-disciplinary service to help ensure easy and swift access to advice
- to ensure that the availability of post-coital IUD fitting for emergency contraception be more adequately provided as another means of reducing unintended conceptions
